events.title: Abyssal Lapidary Steam Page Is Live: Playtest Sign-Ups Now Open!
events.summary: Hello, Lapidary! 💎 We’re excited to finally introduce Abyssal Lapidary to everyone today. Our Steam store page is now officially live, and we’re opening sign-ups for our very first playtest. We’d love for you to join us and help shape the future of the game! What is Abyssal Lapidary? Abyssal Lapidary is a workshop management game centered around ore identification, crafting, and a touch of risk-taking.
